AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Authorized administrator granted access to manage businesses, categories, and usage analytics.

email.description: Verified Google account email address of the administrator.

addedBy.description: UID of the admin who granted access.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was created.

Category.title: Category
Category.description: Business category available for organizing businesses and tailoring review context.

name.description: Display name of the business category.

slug.description: URL-safe lowercase slug for the category.

isDefault.description: True if this is one of the built-in default categories.

createdBy.description: UID of the administrator who created this category.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the category was created.

Business.title: Business
Business.description: Registered business profile with its own Google Review URL and unique customer-facing link.

slug.description: Unique URL slug used for the customer-facing link.

googleReviewUrl.description: Unique Google Review URL specific to this business.

logoUrl.description: Optional store logo URL (https://) or compressed raster image data URI.

enabled.description: Whether the business is active and accessible to customers.

createdBy.description: UID of the administrator who created this business.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the business was added.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the business was last updated.

UsageLog.title: UsageLog
UsageLog.description: Anonymous review generation telemetry event for admin usage statistics (no customer PII).

businessId.description: Document ID of the enabled business.

businessName.description: Snapshot name of the business at generation time.

keywordCount.description: Number of keywords entered by the customer (1 to 10).

isRegeneration.description: Whether this event came from the regenerate button.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the 3 reviews were generated.

BusinessSubscription.title: BusinessSubscription
BusinessSubscription.description: Admin-only subscription and business account billing record linked to a business.

businessId.description: Document ID of the associated business.

plan.description: Subscription tier for the business account.

renewalDate.description: Optional next renewal or expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD).

updatedBy.description: UID of the administrator who last updated this subscription.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the subscription record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the subscription record was last updated.

/categories/{categoryId}.description: Business categories (default and admin-created custom categories).

/businesses/{businessId}.description: Registered businesses with unique customer links and Google Review URLs.

/subscriptions/{businessId}.description: Admin-only business account & subscription management records.

/usageLogs/{logId}.description: Review generation usage statistics log (no PII).
